svg.title: Profile Viewer — developer tool
svg.desc: Any GitHub user, at a glance. Search a username for live stats, a contribution heatmap with a snake, top repositories and a language breakdown. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GitHub API. Live at playful-pudding-f9a7df.netlify.app.
